ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows quadrilateral DEFG as a rectangle, with D and E on the top side and G and F on the bottom side. Thus DE and GF are opposite sides of the rectangle. Reasoning: In a rectangle, opposite sides are congruent, so DE = GF. Set 14 + 2x = 4(x - 3) + 6. Simplify the right side: 4(x - 3) + 6 = 4x - 12 + 6 = 4x - 6. Then 14 + 2x = 4x - 6, so 20 = 2x and x = 10. Substitute into GF: GF = 4(10 - 3) + 6 = 28 + 6 = 34.
